events.description: Tribunal substantiates the complaint
events.quote:
since this complaint was 
substantiated in 2016

events.description: NAN and Canada establish the NAN-Canada Remoteness Quotient Table
events.quote: In 2017, NAN and Canada established the NAN-Canada Remoteness Quotient Table

events.description: ISC and Ontario co-fund the Ontario Special Study of the 1965 Agreement
events.quote: In 2017, ISC and the Government of Ontario co-funded the Ontario Special Study

events.description: Under 2018 CHRT 4, FNCFS agencies may claim actual costs of intake, legal fees, repairs, prevention and FNRS
events.quote: Since the 2018 CHRT 4 decision, rendered on February 1, 2018

events.description: IFSD reports to the AFN in 'Enabling First Nations Children to Thrive'
events.quote:
Enabling First Nations Children to 
Thrive, which is attached as Exhibit C

events.description: Ontario Special Study released and filed with the Tribunal
events.quote: The Ontario Special Study, released and filed with the Tribunal in 2020

events.description: Canada begins funding youth and young adults aging out of care because of COVID-19
events.quote: In August 2020, in recognition of the challenges presented by the COVID-19 pandemic

events.description: Farthing-Nichol starts in the Litigation Management Directorate
events.quote:
I started work 
in the Litigation Management Directorate in June 2021

events.description: Canada makes $947 per capita prevention funding available under 2021 CHRT 12
events.quote: In October 2021, in accordance with the 2021 CHRT 12 consent order

events.description: Agreement-in-Principle on long-term reform reached
events.quote:
On December 31, 2021, the Agreement-in-Principle on Long-Term Reform of the FNCFS 
Program

events.description: Canada begins funding capital projects at actual cost
events.quote:
Since February 2022, Canada has been funding the development, purchase and construction 
of capital projects

events.description: Gideon affidavit reports the reformed funding approach drawn from IFSD Phase 2
events.quote: March 4, 2022 affidavit of Valerie Gideon

events.description: Per capita prevention, FNRS and post-majority funding begin under 2022 CHRT 8
events.quote:
On April 1, 2022, as committed in the Agreement-in-Principle and outlined in the 2022 
CHRT 8 consent order

events.description: ISC publishes its Remoteness Cost Adjustment Factor technical report
events.quote: Development of a Remoteness Cost Adjustment Factor is attached as Exhibit G

events.description: Farthing-Nichol takes up his current role
events.quote:
have been in my current role 
since October 2022

events.description: AFN and Caring Society present the Joint Path Forward proposal, slowing negotiations
events.quote: Discussions slowed in March 2023

events.description: Statistics Canada releases its remoteness classification proposal
events.quote: Toward a Classification of Communities by Remoteness: A Proposal

events.description: ISC secures a revised negotiation mandate
events.quote: In October 2023, ISC secured a revised negotiation mandate

events.description: IFSD issues its draft interim Phase 3 update recommending Indian Registry population
events.quote: March 1, 2024, draft interim update on its Phase 3 research

events.description: ISC officials meet Ontario ministry officials to press reform of the 1965 Agreement
events.quote: February 8, April 4, June 7 and July 26, 2024

events.description: AFN, COO, NAN and Canada reach a tentative national Final Agreement ($47.8 billion)
events.quote: On July 11, 2024, the AFN, COO, NAN and Canada reached a tentative Final Agreement

events.description: Regional engagement sessions on the draft Final Agreement
events.quote: from July to October 2024

events.description: Ontario Chiefs ratify the Final Agreement at NAN and COO assemblies
events.quote:
Ontario Chiefs ratified the Final Agreement during NAN and COO’s assemblies on October 
9 and 10, 2024

events.description: First Nations-in-Assembly vote to reject the Final Agreement
events.quote:
On October 17, however, after two days of discussions at the AFN’s Special 
Chiefs Assembly in Calgary

events.description: AFN resolutions 60/2024 and 61/2024 call for renegotiation
events.quote: On October 18, the First Nations-in-Assembly adopted two resolutions

events.description: Ontario Regional Chief Benedict proposes an Ontario-specific approach
events.quote: On October 25, 2024, Ontario Regional Chief Abram Benedict wrote to the Minister

events.description: Intensive COO-NAN-Canada negotiations begin
events.quote:
Intensive negotiations between COO, NAN and Canada 
began in January 2025

events.description: Tentative Ontario Final Agreement, Trilateral Agreement and off-reserve FNRS agreement concluded
events.quote: A tentative OFA was reached on February 7, 2025

events.description: Farthing-Nichol attends COO and NAN engagement sessions on the OFA
events.quote: on February 13 and 21, 2025

events.description: Ontario Chiefs-in-Assembly approve the OFA
events.quote: On February 25 and 26, 2025, at COO’s and NAN’s respective assemblies

events.description: ISC receives IFSD's pre-production draft of the Phase 3 report
events.quote:
on 
March 6, 2025, the day before this affidavit is being commissioned

events.description: COO and NAN file their joint notice of motion
events.quote:
joint 
notice of motion dated March 7, 2025

events.description: Trilateral Agreement takes effect
events.quote:
The Trilateral 
Agreement becomes effective on April 1, 2025
